name: 午后：第一批客人
intro: 午后的驿站，第一份菜单挂上了墙。门外，送货车停了下来。
The first menu hangs on the wall. Outside the waystation, a delivery cart comes to a stop.
outro: 第一天的账目留下了小小的盈余。晶石亮起，但裂痕仍在。
The first accounts show a modest profit. The crystal shines, but its crack remains.
ending: 驿站完成首次营业。相聚的客人稳定了晶石的光，修复裂痕仍需寻找碎片。
dialogue: 旁白
陆川把蔬菜放上厨房桌，艾莉娅接过清单，先核对了账目。
Lu Chuan sets the vegetables on the kitchen table. Aelia takes the list and checks the accounts first.
陆川
带去三十枚铜币，食材花了十八枚。还有十二枚，够留作明天的采购钱。
I took thirty copper coins and spent eighteen on ingredients. Twelve remain for tomorrow's supplies.
艾莉娅
先把这十二枚单独放好。今天挣的钱，打烊后再算。
Put those twelve aside first. We will count today's earnings after closing.
陆川
好的。预算不会因为我写了“老板”两个字就自己变多。
Right. Writing 'innkeeper' beside my name will not make the budget grow.
艾莉娅
汤已经热了。菜单还是三样，不接我们做不出来的菜。
The soup is hot. Keep the three dishes on the menu. Do not promise food we cannot prepare.
旁白
门口铃响，送货人抬进面粉和鸡蛋，拍了拍袖子上的尘土。
The doorbell rings. A delivery worker brings in flour and eggs, then brushes dust from his sleeves.
送货人
货到了。我还要赶下一趟车，能不能来一碗汤，别放鸡蛋？
Here are your supplies. I have another delivery soon. Could I have soup without eggs?
陆川
蔬菜汤，不加鸡蛋。面包需要带走吗？
Vegetable soup without eggs. Would you like bread to take away?
送货人
对，两片面包带走。汤在这里喝，我只有一刻钟。
Yes, two slices to take away. I will have the soup here. I only have fifteen minutes.
艾莉娅
我来装面包。陆川，给他靠门的座位，车就在窗外。
I will pack the bread. Lu Chuan, give him the seat by the door. His cart is just outside.
陆川
两片面包装袋，汤趁热端上。原来第一笔订单，还考验记忆力。
Two slices in a bag, soup served hot. Our first order is also a memory test.
送货人
听清楚就好。上次有人把“不要鸡蛋”听成了“再加两个”。
Listening is what matters. Last time, someone heard 'no eggs' as 'two more eggs'.
旁白
送货人离开前，两名巡逻守卫推门进来，其中一人扶着同伴坐下。
Before the worker leaves, two patrol guards enter. One helps the other into a chair.
守卫
两份面包，一份煎蛋。汤先给我的同伴，他巡逻时没顾上吃饭。
Two portions of bread and one plate of eggs. Give my companion soup first. He missed his meal on patrol.
陆川
明白，先上热汤。你们从北边回来？
Understood, soup first. Have you come back from the north?
守卫
只巡到矿道外的路障。木牌还在，可昨晚附近又出现了陌生脚印。
Only as far as the barrier outside the mine. The warning sign is still there, but unfamiliar tracks appeared nearby last night.
艾莉娅
入口附近有异常？那就别让赶路的人抄近道。
Something unusual near the entrance? Then travelers should avoid that shortcut.
守卫
我已把消息交给镇里的值守官。我们还没有确认脚印是什么留下的。
I have reported it to the officer in town. We have not identified what left the tracks yet.
旁白
大厅里响起碗勺与谈笑声，吧台后的晶石浮出一层稳定的微光。
Spoons clink and conversation fills the hall. A steady glow appears around the crystal behind the counter.
陆川
艾莉娅，晶石比早上亮了。是不是客人越多，它就能完全修好？
Aelia, the crystal is brighter than this morning. Will more guests repair it completely?
言契系统
相聚稳定封印的能量，碎片修复晶石的结构。当前裂痕仍然存在。
Gathering stabilizes the seal's energy. Fragments restore the crystal's structure. The crack remains.
艾莉娅
客人让它有力气发光，却不能替它补上缺口。两件事都要做。
Our guests give it energy to shine, but they cannot fill the missing piece. We need both.
陆川
今天先把热汤做好。调查矿道的事，等知道更多再决定。
Let us serve good soup today. We will decide about the mine when we know more.
旁白
陆川将已结账的订单夹在账本里。驿站第一次营业，有了可以留下的记录。
Lu Chuan places the paid orders inside the ledger. The waystation's first day now has a record worth keeping.
questions: 预算与营业准备
Why does Aelia ask Lu Chuan to set twelve coins aside?
To buy a royal gift.
To pay for tomorrow's supplies.
To replace the repaired roof.
To close the tavern immediately.
三十枚减去十八枚，剩余十二枚留作次日采购，不提前花掉备用金。
订单细节
What does the delivery worker order?
Egg soup and bread to eat inside.
Two eggs and no bread.
Soup without eggs and two slices of bread to take away.
Cold soup to take away.
送货人要不加鸡蛋的汤，在店里喝；两片面包带走。
信息来源与确定性
What is known about the tracks near the mine?
Their source has not been identified yet.
They were made by the two guards.
They prove that the road is safe.
They appeared inside the tavern.
守卫已报告陌生脚印，但没有确认来源；不能把线索当成定论。
封印规则
Why does the crystal still need fragments?
Guests have made it weaker.
The soup is not hot enough.
The crystal needs a larger counter.
Gathering supplies energy but does not repair its structure.
客人相聚稳定能量，碎片修复结构，二者职责不同。

name: 傍晚：一盏灯的来客
intro: 最后一份午餐刚收走，莉瑟提着灯来到门前。
The last lunch plates have been cleared when Lyse arrives at the door with her lantern.
outro: 三人约好只调查入口附近。夜路上，提灯成为他们共同的方向。
The three agree to inspect only the entrance. On the evening road, the lantern gives them a shared direction.
ending: 莉瑟的提灯与晶石产生共鸣。三人约定结伴调查矿道入口，遇险即撤，不深入未知区域。
dialogue: 旁白
莉瑟在门边停下，先看了墙上的菜单，再看向亮着微光的吧台。
Lyse pauses by the door, looking first at the menu and then at the faintly glowing counter.
莉瑟
你说的座位还空着吗？我想喝碗热汤，也想看看那块晶石。
Is the seat you mentioned still free? I would like some hot soup, and a look at that crystal.
陆川
座位有，汤也有。晶石不能当赠品，只能隔着吧台看。
We have seats and soup. The crystal is not a free gift, though. You can look from this side of the counter.
莉瑟
放心，我不拿走它。我的灯靠近这里时，比在集市安静。
Do not worry, I will not take it. My lantern is calmer here than it was in the market.
艾莉娅
我叫艾莉娅。陆川说你提醒他别独自去矿道，谢谢。
I am Aelia. Lu Chuan said you warned him not to enter the mine alone. Thank you.
莉瑟
莉瑟。今天我只是来借个座位，顺便确认一件事。
Lyse. Today I am here for a seat, and to check something.
旁白
一只淡紫光蝶从灯罩边升起，落在晶石裂缝旁，翅膀轻轻合拢。
A pale violet butterfly rises from the lantern and settles beside the crystal's crack, gently folding its wings.
陆川
它停在缺口边上了。你的灯认识这块晶石？
It stopped beside the missing piece. Does your lantern recognize this crystal?
莉瑟
它追踪相近的魔力，不能告诉我东西的名字。在北边，它感觉到了另一道回声。
It follows related magic, but cannot tell me an object's name. To the north, it sensed another echo.
艾莉娅
灯柄上的纹章……我曾在王室护送队的旗帜上见过。
The crest on the handle... I have seen it on the royal escort's banner.
莉瑟
请先替我保密。我不想让每个人都只听见那个身份，而不听我说什么。
Please keep that to yourself for now. I do not want everyone to hear only my title and ignore what I say.
陆川
这里先按客人的名字记账。你没有义务用一碗汤换自己的秘密。
We write our guests' names in the ledger. A bowl of soup does not oblige you to trade away your secrets.
莉瑟
近三晚，镇北的灯会突然熄灭。熄灭前，我的提灯都指向旧矿道。
For the last three nights, lamps in northern town have gone out suddenly. Before each blackout, my lantern pointed toward the old mine.
艾莉娅
守卫今天也报告了陌生脚印。两个线索有关，但还不能证明原因。
The guards reported unfamiliar tracks today too. The clues may be related, but do not prove the cause.
陆川
如果矿道里有碎片，灯能找到它吗？
If there is a fragment in the mine, can the lantern find it?
莉瑟
只能指方向，无法保证道路安全。我自己没有把握进去。
It can point the way, but cannot guarantee a safe path. I am not confident about going in alone.
艾莉娅
那就结伴，只看入口和第一处岔路。发现危险就撤，不追进深处。
Then we go together, only as far as the entrance and first junction. If we find danger, we retreat instead of pursuing it deeper.
陆川
我负责读标记和记录路线。你挡在前面，莉瑟负责照明和寻找回声。
I will read the markings and record our route. You take the front, while Lyse lights the way and follows the echo.
旁白
艾莉娅把水袋放在门边，又检查了盾带。陆川取下暂停营业的木牌。
Aelia places a water flask by the door and checks her shield strap. Lu Chuan takes down the sign for a temporary closure.
莉瑟
我会让镇门值守的人知道我们的路线。如果迟迟不回，他们至少知道去哪里找。
I will tell the gate watch our route. If we are late, they will know where to look.
陆川
暂停营业，不是关店跑路。回来以后，账本还得接着写。
A temporary closure, not an escape. We still have accounts to finish when we return.
艾莉娅
我们把退路也写清楚。能回来，比走得远更重要。
Write down our return path too. Coming back matters more than going far.
莉瑟
谢谢。有人愿意先听完我的话，比认出纹章更让我安心。
Thank you. Knowing that someone will hear me out is more reassuring than having my crest recognized.
旁白
三人沿石桥走向镇北。提灯照着脚下的路，没有催促任何人加快脚步。
The three cross the stone bridge toward the north. The lantern lights their footing without urging anyone to hurry.
questions: 来访目的
Why does Lyse visit the waystation?
To collect all its earnings.
To replace the menu.
To have soup and examine the crystal.
To recruit every guest.
莉瑟说她想喝热汤，也想查看晶石。
人物态度
How does Lu Chuan respond to Lyse's request for privacy?
He respects her choice to keep her identity private.
He demands her title before serving soup.
He announces the crest to every guest.
He refuses to let her stay.
陆川尊重莉瑟暂时保密的请求，不要求用秘密换取招待。
能力限制与行动边界
What do the three agree to do?
Follow the lantern anywhere without stopping.
Send Lyse into the mine alone.
Wait until the crystal repairs itself.
Inspect the entrance and first junction, retreating if danger appears.
提灯只指方向，不能保证安全；约定只看入口和第一处岔路，遇险撤离。
应急安排
Why will Lyse tell the gate watch their route?
To reserve more soup.
So the watch knows where to look if they return late.
To keep Aelia out of town.
So no one can follow them.
告知路线让值守人员在三人未按时返回时有明确搜寻方向。

name: 旧矿道：第一次主动出发
intro: 旧矿道的警示牌仍在。三人停在入口，先确认了退路。
The warning sign still stands outside the old mine. The three stop at the entrance and check their way back.
outro: 第一块碎晶离开了黑暗。三人没有追逐深处的回声，沿原路返回。
The first crystal fragment leaves the darkness. The three ignore the deeper echo and return along their marked route.
ending: 三人取得第一块修复碎晶，记录异常拖痕后返回。更深处的调查留待准备充分之后。
dialogue: 旁白
入口的铁栏半掩着，地面散落碎石。艾莉娅先用盾沿探了探脚下。
The iron gate stands partly open, with loose stones scattered below. Aelia tests the ground with the edge of her shield.
艾莉娅
站在我身后，别踩右侧松动的石板。我们先确认出口一直可见。
Stay behind me and avoid the loose slab on the right. First, make sure the exit remains in sight.
陆川
木牌写着“西道通风，东道塌陷”。箭头有些褪色，字还看得清。
The sign reads, 'West passage ventilated; east passage collapsed.' The arrows are faded, but the words are clear.
莉瑟
提灯偏向西边。可它只告诉我们方向，不能替我们判断那条路。
The lantern leans west. It gives us a direction, but cannot judge the passage for us.
艾莉娅
西边有风，先看西道。每过一个转角留个标记，塌陷的东道不进。
There is airflow to the west. We inspect that passage first. Mark every turn, and stay out of the collapsed eastern one.
旁白
陆川在入口石壁上画下箭头，记录了第一处转角与出口的位置。
Lu Chuan draws an arrow on the entrance wall, noting the first turn and the position of the exit.
旁白
低矮的影子从废矿车下扑出。艾莉娅举盾，金属撞击声在石壁间回荡。
A low shape lunges from beneath an abandoned cart. Aelia raises her shield, and the impact echoes between the stone walls.
艾莉娅
别往后乱跑！左侧空着，陆川，帮我照清它的落点。
Do not run blindly backward! The left side is clear. Lu Chuan, help me see where it lands.
陆川
卡牌上的“牵制”不是攻击。我先限制它移动，你再把它挡开。
The card says 'restrain', not 'attack'. I will limit its movement, then you can push it back.
莉瑟
灯放左边，不照你的眼睛。它又要扑了！
I will hold the light to the left, away from your eyes. It is about to leap again!
旁白
言契束住怪物的前爪，艾莉娅用盾将它逼回废矿车后。三人重新站稳。
The word pact binds the creature's front claws. Aelia drives it behind the cart with her shield, and the three regain their footing.
艾莉娅
够了，不追。它退开了，我们继续看岔路前的石台。
That is enough. Do not chase it. It has withdrawn; we will inspect the stone ledge before the junction.
陆川
这里的拖痕都朝着石台，不像随便路过。它们可能在找同一个东西。
These drag marks all lead toward the ledge. They do not look random. The creatures may be searching for the same thing.
莉瑟
光蝶停在石缝上了。缝里有一块晶体，颜色和你们吧台上的一样。
The butterfly has stopped over a crack in the rock. There is a crystal inside, the same color as the one on your counter.
艾莉娅
先别伸手。石台底下还有动静，我来挡住。
Do not reach in yet. Something is moving beneath the ledge. I will hold it back.
陆川
标记旁边写着“先松扣，再抬盖”。硬拉会把石缝压紧。
The marking says, 'Release the catch before lifting the cover.' Pulling it directly will tighten the gap.
莉瑟
我找到了扣环。按说明来，晶体没有卡住了。
I found the catch. Following the instructions has freed the crystal.
旁白
莉瑟取出碎晶，用布包好。提灯的光缩成一圈，绕在她掌心。
Lyse lifts out the fragment and wraps it in cloth. The lantern's light gathers into a circle around her palm.
旁白
石台下的守卫兽撞向盾面。艾莉娅退半步站稳，陆川再次展开牵制卡。
The guardian beneath the ledge strikes the shield. Aelia steadies herself a step back as Lu Chuan opens the restraint card again.
艾莉娅
碎片拿到了，沿标记退！我挡最后一下，不需要在这里打到底。
We have the fragment. Follow the marks out! I will block once more. We do not need to fight to the end here.
陆川
原路两处箭头，出口在转角左边。莉瑟先走，我跟着，艾莉娅断后。
Two arrows on our return route; the exit is left after the turn. Lyse goes first, then me, with Aelia covering the rear.
莉瑟
深处还有回声……但我们答应过只看第一处岔路。今天不追了。
There is another echo deeper inside... but we agreed to stop at the first junction. We leave it today.
艾莉娅
回去把拖痕的位置交给守卫。下次来，得有地图和更多准备。
We will report the marks to the guards. Next time, we need a map and better preparation.
旁白
三人走出铁栏时，夜风吹散了石尘。陆川回头确认，每个人都在。
As they step past the iron gate, the night breeze clears the stone dust. Lu Chuan looks back to make sure everyone is there.
questions: 路径判断
Why do they inspect the western passage first?
It has airflow, while the eastern passage is marked as collapsed.
The eastern passage leads straight to the tavern.
They want to hide the exit.
The lantern guarantees that no danger exists.
路牌提示西道通风、东道塌陷，提灯不能代替安全判断。
协作与卡牌含义
How does Lu Chuan help during the first encounter?
He chases the creature into the depths.
He replaces Aelia's shield.
He extinguishes the lantern.
He restricts the creature's movement so Aelia can push it back.
牵制卡限制移动，艾莉娅以盾逼退怪物；没有追击。
操作顺序
What must they do before lifting the cover?
Pull harder on the crystal.
Release the catch.
Move into the collapsed passage.
Break the lantern.
说明明确要求先松扣，再抬盖，硬拉反而压紧石缝。
行动目的与撤退
Why do they return instead of following the deeper echo?
They have lost the fragment.
The inn no longer needs repairs.
They have the fragment and agreed to limit this investigation.
The guards ordered them to abandon the town.
已取得碎晶，遵守只调查入口与第一岔路的约定，准备充分后再探索深处。

name: 夜晚：第一次打烊
intro: 回到驿站，门边的暂停营业牌还在。陆川把碎晶放到吧台上。
Back at the waystation, the temporary closure sign still hangs by the door. Lu Chuan places the fragment on the counter.
outro: 账本合上，门灯留着。地下深处，有谁听见了驿站重新亮起。
The ledger closes, and the light by the door stays on. Deep underground, someone senses the waystation shining again.
ending: 晶石第一道裂痕修复，首次营业完成结算。艾莉娅留下，莉瑟约定再来；陆川得知她的王室身份。
dialogue: 旁白
陆川洗净手上的石尘，莉瑟将包着碎晶的布放在吧台中央。
Lu Chuan washes the stone dust from his hands. Lyse sets the wrapped fragment in the middle of the counter.
艾莉娅
门锁好了，炉火也压小了。现在试着把碎片放到裂口旁。
The door is secured and the hearth is low. Now try placing the fragment beside the crack.
陆川
形状刚好能对上。它好像自己在往缺口里靠。
The shape matches. It seems to be moving toward the gap on its own.
旁白
碎晶融入第一道裂痕，微光沿着石面慢慢铺开。更深的裂缝仍清晰可见。
The fragment joins the first crack, and light spreads slowly across the surface. Deeper fractures remain clearly visible.
言契系统
第一处结构修复完成。封印趋于稳定，尚未完全恢复。
The first structural repair is complete. The seal is becoming stable, but is not fully restored.
莉瑟
光蝶不再绕着这个缺口打转了。至少今天，我们找对了一块。
The butterfly no longer circles this gap. At least today, we found the right piece.
陆川
接下来是账本。今日营业收了二十四枚铜币，食材成本十八枚。
Next, the ledger. Today's sales brought in twenty-four copper coins. Ingredients cost eighteen.
艾莉娅
那是六枚盈余，不是二十四枚。明天还要进货，别把收入全当能花的钱。
That leaves six in profit, not twenty-four. We need supplies tomorrow, so do not treat all revenue as spending money.
陆川
记下了，成本和收入分开。我还留着采购后剩下的十二枚备用金。
Noted: keep costs and revenue separate. I still have the twelve coins left from our supply budget.
莉瑟
第一天能算清楚，比第一天就赚大钱可靠。你们明天还开门吗？
Clear accounts on day one are more reliable than a fortune. Will you be open tomorrow?
陆川
开。先保留今天的菜单，不能因为卖完一锅汤就假装自己是大厨。
Yes. We will keep today's menu. Selling one pot of soup does not make me a master chef.
艾莉娅
也把矿道记录抄一份。明早交给值守官，不把危险只留在我们自己的本子里。
Copy the mine notes too. We will give them to the watch officer tomorrow, rather than keeping the danger in our own notebook.
旁白
门外传来车轮声，一位披深色斗篷的侍从在门廊下停住。
Wheels sound outside. An attendant in a dark cloak stops beneath the porch.
侍从
殿下，马车已备好。您让我们等到的时刻已经到了。
Your Highness, the carriage is ready. The hour you asked us to wait for has arrived.
陆川
殿下？所以灯柄上的纹章，不是买灯时附送的装饰。
Your Highness? So the crest on the handle was not decoration included with the lamp.
莉瑟
不是。对不起，今天先说了一个能让我自在些的名字。
No. I am sorry. Today I used a name that gave me a little freedom.
陆川
你告诉我们的灯和矿道都是真的。名字的另一半，等你想说时再说。
What you told us about the lantern and mine was true. The rest of your name can wait until you want to share it.
莉瑟
谢谢。下次我还是想坐今天这个位置，喝你们的汤。
Thank you. Next time, I would still like this seat and a bowl of your soup.
旁白
马车越过石桥。艾莉娅收好最后一只杯子，陆川将门牌翻到打烊的一面。
The carriage crosses the stone bridge. Aelia puts away the last cup, and Lu Chuan turns the sign to 'closed'.
艾莉娅
如果你还需要人守着这里，我明天也在。不是只等屋顶修好的那一天。
If you still need someone to guard this place, I will be here tomorrow too. I was not waiting only for the roof to be repaired.
陆川
需要。明天的分工还是一起商量，今天就先好好休息。
I do. We will plan tomorrow together. Tonight, let us get some rest.
旁白
账本里夹着采购单、订单和矿道记录。三张纸，填满了陆川当老板的第一天。
The ledger holds a shopping list, paid orders, and mine notes. Three sheets record Lu Chuan's first day as an innkeeper.
陆川
门口那盏灯留着吧。要是有人夜里路过，至少知道这里还有个归处。
Leave the light by the door on. If someone passes at night, they will know there is still a place to return to.
旁白
地下深处，一道低语穿过黑暗：“那间驿站……又亮起来了。”
Deep underground, a whisper travels through the darkness: 'That waystation... it is shining again.'
